```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Here are publication ready theme settings:

These are minimal publication ready themes that can be modified further

```{r}
# theme 1:
library(ggplot2)

theme_publication <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, colour = "grey40")
  )

theme_set(theme_publication) # setting theme for the rest of the document
```
